input.file_text:
#!/bin/bash # Checksum Verification Utility # Verifies the integrity of standardized files using stored checksums set -e CHECKSUM_LOG="checksums.json" VERIFICATION_REPORT="checksum_verification_report.txt" # Colors for output RED='\033[0;31m' GREEN='\033[0;32m' YELLOW='\033[1;33m' BLUE='\033[0;34m' NC='\033[0m' # No Color # Functions log_info() { echo -e "${GREEN}[✓]${NC} $1" } log_error() { echo -e "${RED}[✗]${NC} $1" } log_warning() { echo -e "${YELLOW}[!]${NC} $1" } log_header() { echo -e "\n${BLUE}$1${NC}" echo "================================" } verify_file() { local file_path=$1 local expected_hash=$2 if [ ! -f "$file_path" ]; then log_error "File not found: $file_path" return 1 fi local actual_hash=$(sha256sum "$file_path" | awk '{print $1}') if [ "$expected_hash" = "$actual_hash" ]; then log_info "File verified: $file_path" echo " Expected: $expected_hash" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" echo " Actual: $actual_hash" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" echo " Status: ✓ MATCH" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" return 0 else log_error "Checksum mismatch: $file_path" echo " Expected: $expected_hash" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" echo " Actual: $actual_hash" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" echo " Status: ✗ MISMATCH - File may have been modified!" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" return 1 fi } show_usage() { echo "Checksum Verification Utility" echo "Usage: $0 [OPTIONS]" echo "" echo "Options:" echo " -h, --help Show this help message" echo " -c, --checksum LOG Use specified checksum log (default: checksums.json)" echo " -v, --verbose Show verbose output" echo " --html Generate HTML report" echo "" echo "Examples:" echo " $0 # Verify using default checksums.json" echo " $0 --checksum my_checks.json # Use custom checksum log" echo " $0 --verbose # Show detailed output" } generate_html_report() { local html_file="checksum_verification_report.html" local timestamp=$(date) cat > "$html_file" << 'EOF' Checksum Verification Report

Checksum Verification Report

Generated: TIMESTAMP

EOF # Add verification results if [ -f "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" ]; then echo "
" >> "$html_file" echo "

Verification Results

" >> "$html_file" echo " 
" >> "$html_file"
        cat "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" >> "$html_file"
        echo "
" >> "$html_file" echo "
" >> "$html_file" fi cat >> "$html_file" << 'EOF' EOF sed -i "s/TIMESTAMP/$(date)/" "$html_file" echo "HTML report generated: $html_file" } main() { # Parse arguments VERBOSE=0 GENERATE_HTML=0 while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do case $1 in -h|--help) show_usage exit 0 ;; -c|--checksum) CHECKSUM_LOG="$2" shift 2 ;; -v|--verbose) VERBOSE=1 shift ;; --html) GENERATE_HTML=1 shift ;; *) log_error "Unknown option: $1" show_usage exit 1 ;; esac done # Clear previous report > "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" # Check if checksum log exists if [ ! -f "$CHECKSUM_LOG" ]; then log_error "Checksum log not found: $CHECKSUM_LOG" echo "Please run standardization first or use -c to specify the log file." exit 1 fi # Display header clear log_header "CHECKSUM VERIFICATION UTILITY" { echo "Checksum Verification Report" echo "Generated: $(date)" echo "Checksum Log: $CHECKSUM_LOG" echo "" } | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" # Extract data from JSON echo "Loading checksums from $CHECKSUM_LOG..." | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" # Check if jq is available for JSON parsing if command -v jq &> /dev/null; then source_file=$(jq -r '.source_file' "$CHECKSUM_LOG") source_hash=$(jq -r '.source_checksum_sha256' "$CHECKSUM_LOG") output_file=$(jq -r '.output_file' "$CHECKSUM_LOG") output_hash=$(jq -r '.output_checksum_sha256' "$CHECKSUM_LOG") timestamp=$(jq -r '.timestamp' "$CHECKSUM_LOG") algorithm=$(jq -r '.algorithm' "$CHECKSUM_LOG") else # Fallback to grep if jq not available log_warning "jq not found, using grep for parsing" source_file=$(grep '"source_file"' "$CHECKSUM_LOG" | cut -d'"' -f4) source_hash=$(grep '"source_checksum_sha256"' "$CHECKSUM_LOG" | head -1 | cut -d'"' -f4) output_file=$(grep '"output_file"' "$CHECKSUM_LOG" | cut -d'"' -f4) output_hash=$(grep '"output_checksum_sha256"' "$CHECKSUM_LOG" | cut -d'"' -f4) timestamp=$(grep '"timestamp"' "$CHECKSUM_LOG" | cut -d'"' -f4) algorithm=$(grep '"algorithm"' "$CHECKSUM_LOG" | cut -d'"' -f4) fi { echo "Algorithm: $algorithm" echo "Standardization Timestamp: $timestamp" echo "" } | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" # Verify source file log_header "Verifying Source File" { echo "File: $source_file" echo "" } | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" SOURCE_VALID=0 if verify_file "$source_file" "$source_hash"; then SOURCE_VALID=1 echo "" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" else echo "" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" log_warning "Source file verification failed - file may have been modified" fi # Verify output file log_header "Verifying Output File" { echo "File: $output_file" echo "" } | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" OUTPUT_VALID=0 if verify_file "$output_file" "$output_hash"; then OUTPUT_VALID=1 echo "" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" else echo "" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" log_warning "Output file verification failed - file may have been modified" fi # Summary log_header "VERIFICATION SUMMARY" { echo "" if [ $SOURCE_VALID -eq 1 ] && [ $OUTPUT_VALID -eq 1 ]; then echo "✓ ALL FILES VERIFIED SUCCESSFULLY" echo " Both source and output files match their stored checksums." echo " Data integrity is confirmed." else echo "✗ VERIFICATION FAILED" if [ $SOURCE_VALID -eq 0 ]; then echo " ✗ Source file checksum mismatch" fi if [ $OUTPUT_VALID -eq 0 ]; then echo " ✗ Output file checksum mismatch" fi echo "" echo "This may indicate:" echo " - Files have been modified or corrupted" echo " - Files have been moved or renamed" echo " - Checksum log is for different files" fi echo "" } | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" # Generate HTML if requested if [ $GENERATE_HTML -eq 1 ]; then echo "" | tee -a "$VERIFICATION_REPORT" generate_html_report fi # Show report location log_info "Detailed report saved to: $VERIFICATION_REPORT" # Return appropriate exit code if [ $SOURCE_VALID -eq 1 ] && [ $OUTPUT_VALID -eq 1 ]; then exit 0 else exit 1 fi } # Run main function main "$@"
